name: adai-hub
description: ADAI Hub — site da ADAI (Next.js) + CMS (Strapi)

scripts.setup: yarn install && yarn setup:next && yarn setup:strapi
scripts.dev: concurrently -n strapi,next -c magenta,cyan "cd strapi && yarn develop" "wait-on http://localhost:1337/_health && cd next && yarn dev"
scripts.build: cd strapi && yarn build && cd ../next && yarn build
